description: Multiple-choice quiz questions, each with the correct answer, three wrong answers and the four options in a fixed A-D order with the right letter, from the community-written and moderator-reviewed Open Trivia Database (CC BY-SA 4.0). Pick a category (e.g. sports, geography, film, history) and difficulty, or mix. Good for pub quiz rounds, classroom quizzes and team events. Questions are drawn at random each call and the bank is mostly English-language general trivia; it is not a curriculum-aligned or UK-specific source, and a few answers may date. (cost: 1 credit)

amount.description: integer, optional, number of questions 1-50, default 10

category.description: string or integer, optional, category id (9-32) or name such as "sports", "geography", "film", "music", "history", "science", "maths"; default any category (see trivia_categories)

difficulty.description: string, optional, easy | medium | hard; default a mix

name: trivia_questions
